boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Scripps College
boards.description: Ten food-focused destinations with published evening availability in the Claremont Colleges area and Claremont Village.

cards.title: The Coop Fountain
cards.subtitle: Smith Campus Center, Pomona College
cards.notes: When the fall term is in session, use the Coop’s late-night window for food and a quick break near the north side of the consortium.
cards.short_summary: Pomona College’s campus-center counter publishes an 8–11 p.m. late-night offering.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona College states that the Coop Fountain offers late-night food from 8 to 11 p.m.; its page says it will reopen for Fall 2026.
cards.access_notes: Closed for summer; Pomona College says it will reopen for the Fall 2026 semester, with late-night offerings 8–11 p.m.

cards.title: Sancho’s Tacos
cards.subtitle: 131 N Yale Ave, Claremont
cards.notes: Plan this Village stop for Friday or Saturday, when the restaurant’s published schedule extends to 11 p.m.; confirm before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A taco restaurant on Yale Avenue with documented 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Sancho’s Tacos lists its Claremont location at 131 N Yale Ave and lists Friday–Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published Claremont hours: Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–11 p.m.; other days close earlier.

cards.title: House of Pong
cards.subtitle: 238 Yale Ave, Claremont
cards.notes: Use the late Friday or Saturday schedule for a seated Asian-fusion meal on Yale; check the day-specific closing time before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Yale Avenue restaurant with a published midnight Friday close and 11 p.m. Saturday close.
cards.evidence_claim: House of Pong lists 238 Yale Avenue and publishes Friday hours until midnight and Saturday hours until 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Friday 11:30 a.m.–12 a.m.; Saturday 11:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; Wednesday–Thursday until 10 p.m.

cards.title: La Popular Claremont
cards.subtitle: 235 N Yale Ave, Claremont
cards.notes: For a later dinner in the Village, consult the location’s schedule and arrive with time to order rather than relying on closing-time service.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Claremont restaurant whose official location page lists 11 p.m. and midnight evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: La Popular lists its Claremont restaurant at 235 N Yale Avenue and publishes hours as late as midnight Saturday and 11 p.m. on several other days.
cards.access_notes: Published location hours include 11 p.m. Wednesday and Sunday, and 12 a.m. Saturday; verify the full current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Eureka! Claremont
cards.subtitle: Claremont Packing House, 580 W First St
cards.notes: Use the Packing House location for a later meal, keeping the official day-by-day schedule handy because Friday and Saturday run latest.
cards.short_summary: A Packing House restaurant listing midnight closes most days and 1 a.m. closes on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Eureka!’s official Claremont page lists 580 West First Street and hours until midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday; 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Restaurant service availability may differ near close.

cards.title: The Press Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 129 Harvard Ave, Claremont
cards.notes: Check the calendar and current kitchen details, then use this Harvard Avenue restaurant for an evening meal during its published late operating window.
cards.short_summary: A Claremont restaurant with official posted operating hours through midnight or 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Press Restaurant lists 129 Harvard Avenue, Claremont, and operating hours until midnight Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and until 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published operating hours: midnight Monday–Wednesday and Sunday; 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. Check current food service before going.

cards.title: The Whisper House
cards.subtitle: 502 W First St, Claremont
cards.notes: For a later dinner in the Packing House area, use the published Thursday–Saturday schedule and confirm reservation or walk-in availability first.
cards.short_summary: A West First Street restaurant with official midnight hours on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The Whisper House lists its location at 502 W First Street and publishes midnight closing on Thursday–Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Thursday–Friday 4 p.m.–midnight; Saturday 10 a.m.–midnight; Sunday and Monday–Wednesday close at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Union on Yale
cards.subtitle: 232 Yale Ave, Claremont
cards.notes: Aim for the Friday or Saturday dinner service if you need the latest listed window, and verify table availability directly before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: A Yale Avenue restaurant whose official dinner schedule runs to 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Union on Yale lists 232 Yale Avenue and publishes Friday–Saturday dinner hours from 4 to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published dinner hours: 4–10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4–11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Aruffo’s Italian Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 126 Yale Ave, Claremont
cards.notes: Use the Friday or Saturday evening schedule for a later sit-down meal in the Village and confirm the restaurant’s service timing before you go.
cards.short_summary: A historic-Claremont-Village Italian restaurant with official 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Aruffo’s lists 126 Yale Ave, Claremont, and publishes Friday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Walter’s Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 306 Yale Ave, Claremont
cards.notes: For a late Village dinner, use the restaurant’s published weekend operating schedule and contact the venue for current seating or kitchen details.
cards.short_summary: A Yale Avenue restaurant with City-documented proposed operating hours through midnight on Thursday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: A City of Claremont Planning Commission packet identifies Walter’s Restaurant at 306 Yale Avenue and states proposed operating hours through midnight Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: City of Claremont Planning Commission Meeting Packet
cards.access_notes: City packet states proposed operating hours of 9 a.m.–midnight Thursday–Saturday; verify current hours directly before visiting.

warnings: The Coop Fountain is closed for summer and its cited page says it will reopen in Fall 2026. Walter’s cited City packet describes proposed operating hours, so current hours should be verified directly.
